channel.title: Frontier Watch — AI × Supply Chain
channel.description: Weekly intelligence briefing: AI developments across planning, procurement, manufacturing, commercial and the data/agent stack.

item.title: Edition 07 (Week 38, 2026) — Agents got job titles; verifying their work became the constraint
item.description: Six-week catch-up edition (Aug 6 – Sep 17). Salesforce ships seven named role-agents including one for supply chain plus a multi-week runtime; a 3PL commits to twenty agents and a manufacturer runs 800 (one of them cutting back orders 25%); AI freight gets a unit of measure (~100,000 truckloads per gigawatt) with a visible expiry date; Acumatica's AI becomes purchasable at 2026 R2 with no published unit price; and the first measured study of industrial agent adoption finds verification, not capability, is the binding constraint. 14 signals, 7 patterns, cannabis lens active.

item.title: Edition 06 (Week 32, 2026) — The buildout leaves the data center: trucks, warehouses, robots
item.description: AI demand reaches ground freight (~500k data-center truckloads YTD; long-distance LTL +18%), Amazon crosses one million robots and guides $220B capex, Prologis agrees a ~£14B Segro takeover — and first-party MCP connectors arrive within a week of the final (P5 advancing; P6's demand-domain confirmer fires; P7 promoted to hardening). 13 signals, 7 patterns, 5 advancing.

item.title: Edition 05 (Week 31, 2026) — The standard shipped; the operators posted the numbers
item.description: The MCP 2026-07-28 final ships as promised and P5's confirmer fires; UPS (68.5% automated volume, ~28% lower cost/piece) and C.H. Robinson publish automation unit economics; the P3 pricing deep-dive finds per-outcome price tags multiplying; agentic checkout stalls and regroups around discovery. 13 signals, 7 patterns, 6 advancing.

item.title: Edition 04 (Week 30, 2026) — The agent layer becomes an industry
item.description: Packaged agent platforms go GA above the ERP stack (DeepFabric; Auger's $150M), the adoption reality check lands (4 in 5 see no P&L impact), the P6 quiet streak breaks — and P7 opens: AI as freight demand. 13 signals, 7 patterns, 5 advancing.

item.title: Edition 03 (Week 29, 2026) — The customer side took over the story
item.description: FedEx targets agents in over half of workflows by 2028, Walmart runs agentic end-to-end flows, the planning majors converge on in-model agents — and NetSuite ships a first-party MCP connector (P5 confirmer fired). 13 signals, 6 patterns, 1 watch item resolved.

item.title: Edition 02 (Week 28, 2026) — The confirmers started firing
item.description: Outcome pricing reached the ERP suite (SAP Joule; Deloitte publishes the accounting), commerce agents went GA inside ChatGPT and Google, and Schneider moved to buy Cognite — the context-layer thesis with a price tag. 15 signals, 6 patterns, 2 watch items resolved.

item.title: Edition 01 (Week 27, 2026) — The execution layer arrived
item.description: Platforms across planning, manufacturing, CRM and logistics shipped agents that act — and the pricing model just flipped to outcomes. 15 signals, 6 patterns, first edition baseline.
